method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: BUNDLE of 3 reports; top-level recon is report 1 (pages 1-3, the 12/15/2020 filing covering 10/27/2020-12/15/2020). One row 300.00 = p2's printed TOTAL 300.00 = the cover's line-1 CUMULATIVE cell. It is NOT the THIS REPORT cell, which the filer marked with a slashed zero (nothing raised in this period). So the LEDGER IS CYCLE-TO-DATE while the cover is per-period - scope=cumulative. The same Form A sheet is photocopied under all three reports, which is the direct evidence for that reading.

expenditures.detail: Report 1. Five inked rows, provably complete (row-count gate). They sum to 1195.91. The sheet's own printed TOTAL reads 1,195.61 and the cover's line-3 carries the same 1,195.61, so the rows match NEITHER printed figure: this is a DELTA, published verbatim with needs_review on every row. Traced on the page: the excess is exactly 0.30, and TWO single-digit hypotheses would each close it - row 3 as 812.57 instead of 812.87, or row 4 as 100.58 instead of 100.88. The ink was escalated to 1200 dpi on ALL THREE photocopies of this sheet (pp.3, 6 and 9) and reads .87 and .88 in every one; the scan's own resolution is the limit, and agreement across the three copies is correlated error, not evidence. Because the arithmetic cannot single out WHICH cell to change, NO row was adjusted - the eager move here would be to pick one. Corroboration that the printed 1,195.61 is the filer's own figure and not a transcription slip: the cover's balance line (-895.61 = 300.00 - 1,195.61) closes on it exactly.

gates.page_subtotal: Form A: p2/p5/p8 rows 300.00 = printed TOTAL 300.00 on each sheet - EXACT, gate fired and closed three times. Form B: p3/p6/p9 rows 1195.91 vs printed TOTAL 1,195.61 on each sheet - THE GATE WOULD NOT CLOSE, on any of the three copies, by the same 0.30. Both figures are named here and in the row notes; nothing was adjusted to force it.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returns geometry_status 'gaps' on every schedule page of this filing (this form rules the Amount column on a finer pitch than the name columns) and 'no-reliable-geometry' on p2 (the scan carries a heavy blue scanner-edge artifact down the left margin) - so rows were counted by INK against the rules measured from 600 dpi column strips. Form A: exactly 1 inked line on each of p2, p5, p8. Form B: exactly 5 contiguous inked lines on each of p3, p6, p9, with row 6 verified EMPTY on all three. Names equal amounts on every side (field-shift screen passed).
gates.geometry_proof: Form A - p2: row-1 amount crop renders '$300.00', control one pitch below renders an empty '$' cell; p8: same, renders '$300.00' then empty. Form B - p9: first-row crop renders '$7.16', last(5th)-row crop renders '$175.00', control one pitch below renders an empty '$' cell; p6 and p3 verified the same way with 600 dpi column strips showing all five rows plus an empty sixth. Geometry for p2 was placed by proof crop rather than by rowbands (which could not read that page's grid) and is stated at lower precision accordingly.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 prints -895.61 = 300.00 - 1,195.61 and closes on the filer's own figures in all three reports. CROSS-FILING CHAIN INSIDE THE BUNDLE RUN: report 2 (earliest, 6/17/2020) carries 300.00 / 1,195.61 in its LAST column; reports 3 (10/27/2020) and 1 (12/15/2020) each carry 300.00 / 1,195.61 in LAST and repeat them in CUMULATIVE with slashed zeros in THIS - so the chain is consistent end to end and the covers are not swapped. Note the corroboration for the Form B delta: had the itemised 1195.91 been the filer's intended total, the balance would read -895.91; it reads -895.61 on every cover, i.e. the printed 1,195.61 is the filer's own figure.

escalation_note: 600 dpi column strips of the Amount column on p3, p6 and p9; 1200 dpi single-cell crops of Form B rows 1, 3, 4 and 5 on p6 and p9 with ImageMagick -normalize and 300-350% upscaling; 1200 dpi crops of the date and name columns to settle '3/12/20' (vs 3/13) and the row-2 surname; 600 dpi first/last/control geometry crops on p2, p3, p6, p8, p9.
notes: Chunk file says candidate 'Gary L. Christensen', office 'Recorder', n_reports 3 - all CONFIRMED at the pages ('Full Name of Candidate: Gary L. Christensen'; 'Office: Recorder' on all three covers). Form generation is the 2018-era 'WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE / FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT' citing Washington County Code 1-7-1, with the 4-line cover grid, an In-Kind column and printed schedule TOTALS. THE THREE REPORTS ARE STAPLED OUT OF CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER: pages 1-3 are the LAST filing (12/15/2020), pages 4-6 the FIRST (received JUN 17 2020), pages 7-9 the middle one (10/27/2020). THE SAME FORM A AND FORM B SHEETS ARE PHOTOCOPIED UNDER ALL THREE REPORTS - identical rows, identical printed totals - which is what decides scope: the LEDGER is cycle-to-date (cumulative) while the covers are per-period. Rows are emitted once per report with report_no and a restarted line_no as the contract requires, so a downstream consumer must NOT sum the three reports' rows as if they were distinct transactions. The report-2 cover is MIS-COLUMNED by the filer (cycle figures entered under 'Totals from LAST Report', THIS and CUMULATIVE left blank) - recorded verbatim, never repaired. Form B carries a genuine 0.30 delta against its own printed total on all three copies (see recon detail). Privacy: every cover prints the candidate's street address, ZIP, home phone and business phone; the single Form A row's address cell holds a street address - all discarded at read time.
